fields.why: IgM positivity is reported and ranked by age group among children (6-8 years highest, then 9-11) and among adults (40-49 highest), from the Figure 1 and 2 age-group panels.
Age is the only SPD compared across 3+ groups; HHS region is geography, and race/ethnicity appears only as a limitation.
The chi-square tests compare periods within children and within adults, and the t-tests compare testing volumes; none spans the age groups. The mechanical flags are false alarms.
